desc:
⚾ THROW THE BALL AS FAR AS YOU CAN! ⚾

Train your skill, throw further, and reach THE END of every world!

💪 TRAIN on training zones to boost your skill
🔁 REBIRTH to level up faster and unlock new zones
🌍 8 WORLDS to conquer – can you defeat GRUMBO?
🔥 POWERS – Fire Boost, Frost Dash, Thunder Strike, Void Warp, Rainbow Nova & more!
🥚 HATCH PETS that make you even stronger
⭐ RARE THROWS – land a Black Flash (1 in 100) or a UNITED STATES OF SMASH (1 in 1000)!
🎁 DAILY REWARDS – log in 7 days to get the LIMITED Void Bat!
⏰ PLAYTIME REWARDS & offline training – get stronger even while you're away

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
